name: seated lean back on a chair
description: A seated lean back that wakes up the abs by holding the torso against gravity.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.
